detail.body:
## Summary

Bump `feat/1.29.0-megatron` from 1.29.0 to 1.29.1 in CMake, the C++ version header, and the Python package.

## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of LICENSE.txt.
- [x] I ran pre-commit on all changed files; all hooks passed.
- [x] I reviewed the applicable AGENTS.md rules and comments. This change complies.
- [x] I added change type, affected area, and originator labels.

## Affected area

Build, packaging, or installation.

## Why

Identify the updated Megatron branch as patch release 1.29.1.

## Related issues

None.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Only version values change.

## Testing

- `pre-commit run --files CMakeLists.txt include/cudnn_frontend_version.h python/cudnn/__init__.py` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Python source check of the CMake version, C++ version macros, and Python AST — all equal 1.29.1.
- GPU tests were not run; this change only updates version values.
detail.title: Bump Megatron branch version to 1.29.1

files.patch:
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
 
 cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.23)
 
-project(cudnn_frontend VERSION 1.29.0)
+project(cudnn_frontend VERSION 1.29.1)
 
 option(CUDNN_FRONTEND_SKIP_JSON_LIB "Defines whether FE should not include nlohmann/json.hpp." OFF)
 option(CUDNN_FRONTEND_BUILD_SAMPLES "Defines if samples are built or not." ON)

@@ -7,6 +7,6 @@
 
 #define CUDNN_FRONTEND_MAJOR_VERSION 1
 #define CUDNN_FRONTEND_MINOR_VERSION 29
-#define CUDNN_FRONTEND_PATCH_VERSION 0
+#define CUDNN_FRONTEND_PATCH_VERSION 1
 #define CUDNN_FRONTEND_VERSION \
     ((CUDNN_FRONTEND_MAJOR_VERSION * 10000) + (CUDNN_FRONTEND_MINOR_VERSION * 100) + CUDNN_FRONTEND_PATCH_VERSION)
